caption: A boat tied to a dock by a long line drifts away on the tide until the line goes taut and stops it.

sa.check: A boat is tied to a dock by a line.
The boat drifts away from the dock.
The boat is stopped by the line.
The line is long, so the boat drifts some distance before it tightens.
The drift comes first, then the taut line, then the stop.

pc.expect: The line goes from slack, drooping or in the water, to straight at the moment the boat reaches its length; it does not stretch.
pc.fail: The line stretches; or it stays curved while the boat is held; or it is taut while the boat is still beside the dock.

pc.expect: The boat stops the instant the line straightens and then swings at the end of the line.
pc.fail: The boat keeps drifting with the line taut; or it stops before the line is straight; or the line goes taut and the dock post comes away.

pc.expect: While the line is slack the boat drifts freely and slowly, and once held it swings.
pc.fail: The boat speeds up as it drifts; or reverses on its own; or stops in open water with the line slack.

pc.expect: A slack line droops into the water, and a taut line runs straight above it.
pc.fail: Slack line floats in the air; or the taut line sags into the water; or the boat lifts.

pc.expect: One boat, one line and one dock keep their number.
pc.fail: The boat vanishes or a second appears; or the line passes through the dock; or the boat turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The boat, the line and the dock stay the same.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or the line changes; or the dock rearranges.
